scripts.lint: pnpm lint:js && pnpm lint:backend && pnpm lint:collector
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm lint:js:fix && pnpm lint:backend:fix && pnpm lint:collector:fix
scripts.lint:backend: cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:backend:fix: cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.lint:collector: cd apps/collector && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:collector:fix: cd apps/collector && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.vulture:backend: cd apps/backend && uv run vulture slowpoke_backend tests
scripts.vulture:collector: cd apps/collector && uv run vulture collector.py modal_app.py tests
scripts.format: pnpm format:js && pnpm format:backend && pnpm format:collector
scripts.format:backend: cd apps/backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:collector: cd apps/collector && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: pnpm format:js:check && pnpm format:backend:check && pnpm format:collector:check
scripts.format:backend:check: cd apps/backend && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format:collector:check: cd apps/collector && uv run ruff format --check .
